anomalies.observed: On the Thermocouples sheet the third zone's chip-select, U10 (MAX31855KASA) pin 6 ~{CS}, is labeled NET0013. On the Microcontroller sheet the SPI/CS net cluster driven by the ESP32-C3 (U2) carries NET0008, NET0011, NET0018, NET0007 and NET0006 — NET0013 never appears there, and NET0018 appears only on the MCU side with no thermocouple counterpart. The two chip-select nets therefore do not join across the sheets.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires three independent chip-selects, each driven by the MCU: '~{CS} (pin 6) on U2/U3/U4 goes to separate nets CS0/CS1/CS2, driven by ESP32 GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 respectively' and firmware NUM_THERMOCOUPLES = 3. The third CS line must be a single net shared between the MCU output pin and U10 pin 6.

evidence.quote: Thermocouples sheet: U10 MAX31855KASA, pin 6 CS → NET0013 (U6 CS → NET0008, U8 CS → NET0007)
Microcontroller sheet: ESP32-C3-MINI-1 (U2) SPI cluster labels NET0008 / NET0011 / NET0018 / NET0007 / NET0006 — no NET0013
Each chip has its own independent chip-select: ~{CS} (pin 6) on U2/U3/U4 goes to separate nets CS0/CS1/CS2, driven by ESP32 GPIO4/GPIO6/GPIO7 respectively.

anomalies.impact: The third thermocouple's chip-select is not connected to the MCU (the MCU pin instead sits on NET0018, which reaches no thermocouple, while U10's CS floats on NET0013). The firmware cannot select zone 3, so that thermocouple is unreadable; a floating CS on a shared SPI bus can also corrupt reads of the other two channels.

parsed.summary: The power, heater, USB and two thermocouple channels match the specification, but the third thermocouple's chip-select net (NET0013 on U10 pin 6) has no matching net on the MCU sheet (which instead shows NET0018), leaving zone 3's CS unconnected — an open_connection deviation from the intended 3-channel SPI design.
